projectLandscape.title: Project landscape
projectLandscape.intro: Compare Nordic and transferable projects without conflating strategic relevance with strength of documentation. Cutoff {cutoff}.
projectLandscape.internalNote: GO: internal prioritisation and method choices. NO-GO: external impact claims, automated intake or contact. Candidates and owner claims are unverified.

coverage.title: Coverage before ranking
coverage.description: Cells show verified profiles, not equal quality or completeness. One profile is a thin trace; five or more indicate broader coverage.
coverage.geographyNote: Greenland and Åland have programme coverage, but documented gaps remain at project level. Sápmi is represented by Biebmolassi and MÁHTUT.
coverage.thinMobile: Thinnest themes: seafood 2 · circularity 3 · local food 4. Counts show occurrence, not qualitative depth.
coverage.thinDetail: Thinnest thematic traces: seafood (2), circularity (3) and local food (4). Counts show occurrence, not qualitative depth.

ranking.title: Top 10 for strategic learning
ranking.description: Priority and evidence are shown as separate measures.

evidence.title: What the evidence actually supports
evidence.description: No profile reaches 5/5. A large number of owner sources does not make a project more independently documented.

register.title: Explore the main register
register.description: Search and filter without changing the canonical ranking.
register.emptyDetail: Reset the filters or use a broader search term.

candidates.title: Candidate gate
candidates.description: The longlist is an operational queue, not a ranking. Only profiles with independently verified method, status and source links can move into the main register.

projectLandscape.footer: This page reads the committed JSONL registers directly and introduces no separate source of truth. Regenerate the report with <reportCommand>npm run landscape:report</reportCommand>, validate with <validateCommand>npm run landscape:validate</validateCommand>, and use the completion register for human, source and publication gates.
projectLandscape.fallback: The landscape register could not be read. Check that <landscapePath>research/landscape/</landscapePath> is included in the build, then run <validateCommand>npm run landscape:validate</validateCommand>.
